Reference / runtime/checksum

runtime/checksum#

The native layer under checksum/adler32, checksum/crc: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under checksum/adler32, checksum/crc: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Checksums of checksum/crc and checksum/adler32 (#193), continued from a seed. checksum_crc32 takes and gives a finalized CRC-32/ISO-HDLC (as zlib); checksum_crc16 runs the CCITT register (polynomial 0x1021, MSB first, no reflection, no final xor) from the seed; checksum_adler32 gives the packed sums of RFC 1950, normalizing both halves of the seed.

Public API#

native checksum_crc32#

native checksum_crc32(origin is @byte, initial is int) is int

The CRC-32 of origin, continuing from initial.

native checksum_crc16#

native checksum_crc16(origin is @byte, initial is int) is int

The CRC-16 of origin, continuing from initial.

native checksum_adler32#

native checksum_adler32(origin is @byte, initial is int) is int

The Adler-32 of origin, continuing from initial.
